Clinical trial title: ‘Human lysozyme goat milk for the prevention of GVHD in patients with blood cancer undergoing a donor stem cell transplant’
Specific intervention: Human lysozyme goat milk (obtained from goats that have been genetically engineered to produce human lysozyme in their milk; human lysozyme is a natural enzyme found in human milk and acts as an antimicrobial) vs no treatment in patients undergoing allo-HCT
Primary outcome: Ability to consume human lysozyme goat milk, volume consumed, toxicity, adverse effects

Clinical trial title: ‘Lactobacillus plantarum in preventing acute GVHD in children undergoing donor stem cell transplant’
Specific intervention: L. plantarum vs placebo in paediatric patients undergoing allo-HCT
Primary outcome: Incidence of grade I–IV GVHD up to 120 days after allo-HCT
